name: @glinr/theauth-benchmarks
description: Benchmark harness for the TheAuth SDK. Not published and not a workspace member: it has no dependencies of its own and loads the built SDK from packages/core/dist.

scripts.bench:smoke: node run.mjs --profile smoke --out results/smoke.json && node report.mjs results/smoke.json --out results/smoke.md
scripts.bench: node --expose-gc run.mjs --profile full --out results/full.json && node report.mjs results/full.json --out results/full.md
